selection: Explicit before call; no automatic method, precision or resource fallback
scope: Frozen-common all-existing-private-RS native mono PolyFormer adaptation of author Identity raw-score force

execution.final_partial_batch: Future fitter must declare its policy before execution and use the actual B throughout R, C and CE

formula.score: Selected raw output score, with q obtained using create_graph=True
formula.gradient: g[i,b]=A[b]^T q[i,b] over all N*F coordinates
formula.distance: Explicit difference, square and full N,F sum
formula.distance_cotangent: -softmax_(j,b)(-D/h)/(B*h), obtained through native existing repulsion VJP on complete D with frozen h
formula.CE: Sum of mean-per-member CE; no extra 1/M
formula.self: Retain KDE self entries; exact-zero distance and live derivative at equality

autograd.outer_graph: Live q and logits built once at unchanged snapshot; all actual enabled private R/S retain their mixed derivative path
autograd.forward: Custom boundary streams direct values without large retained graphs; complete D determines one h, R and C
autograd.backward: Recompute local q leaf per target; pair VJPs end at normalized live direction; accumulate w in fixed j order; one normalization-and-A VJP per target; return full q cotangent to outer graph
autograd.graph_lifetime: Pair graph ends after normalized-direction VJP; target graph ends after q VJP; model graph ends after one complete outer backward
autograd.references_and_h: Stopped; no reference derivative, median derivative or derivative of the saved global cotangent during the q-to-parameter VJP
autograd.higher_order_scope: Mixed score/private derivative required for FoRDE only; differentiating the optimizer step or custom backward further is not qualified

custody: fixed P COO bytes and coalescence flag
initial_implementation: Retain existing descriptor and charge its hashing, copies, Gram and token reconstruction; use source einsum signature with target slice length one; full N-by-F arrays per target; explicit pair difference reductions

failure.valid_zero_cases: Zero norm and zero median remain valid under existing source constants
failure.action: Stop before any optimizer commit; emit exact stage, reason and attempted-work receipt; no fallback or candidate guard
failure.optimizer: Future source optimizer remains ordinary coupled-decay Nesterov SGD, momentum 0.9 and fresh state; learning rate, schedule and duration are not adopted here
